data.subject: Local Ledger four-week pilot
data.body:
Hi Fourthstone team,

Your most recent 13F, for the period ended June 30, 2026, shows positions in AVBH, MRBK, and FNWB.

A recent signal: ISTR reported Q2 2026 total interest income of $53.2M versus $35.4M a year earlier (+50.5% y/y). (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1602658/000143774926026348/0001437749-26-026348-index.htm)

I publish a free weekly issue based on public records and can offer Fourthstone a four-week fund pilot.

Reply "no" and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
